title: Murder in the Stars
summary: A famous astronomer is found dead at the bottom of a cliff, during a rare planetary alignment.
method: The astronomer had already planned to fake his death due to allegations that he plagiarized his latest findings. He set up a rope ladder on the cliff and when the group found him, he wasn't actually dead. However, he was actually murdered in the window when the group called for help.
motive: The killer lost their respect for him due to the plagiarism allegations.
tags: victim fakes their death then dies for real
